changelog:
- Premium Light Theme Overhaul: Full Opera-inspired light styling across home screen, bottom menu, Live Pulse news briefing, top hero buttons, command search bar, dropdowns, and settings.
- Start Page & Horizontal Feed Touch Fix: Completely disabled pull-to-refresh interference on the home start page and horizontal trending news carousels, guaranteeing 100% smooth, glitch-free horizontal scrolling.
- Theme & Wallpaper Decoupling: Fully decoupled light/dark mode from background wallpapers so switching themes preserves user-selected wallpapers without blank screen resets.
- Search Bar Visibility: Restored dark text and contrast in search input, voice search, tab badge, and 3-dots menu under light mode.
